findings.title: Lane result step can lock SubSet twice and deadlock
findings.fix: Two-phase apply: under the lock, validate (id, rev), update memory and compute an action (None/Persist/Remove(expect_rev)); release the guard, then persist() or remove_sub(id, Some(rev)); add a race test against a key-changing upsert

findings.title: Unclear meaning of a 500 when a route save fails
findings.fix: Either roll back on save failure or keep the change, mark dirty and retry the flush; test a forced write failure plus restart for subscribe and unsubscribe

findings.title: Invalid P-256 scalar probability is about 2^-32, not 2^-128
rand_core/getrandom is enabled through aes-gcm defaults via feature unification
findings.fix: Reword the reason or use SigningKey::random(&mut OsRng)

findings.title: Wrong list of shared lockfile risks (serde_json is dev-only, serde is off)
findings.fix: List http ^1.4.2 and the aes-gcm/hkdf 0.13/sha2 0.11 dependencies instead

findings.title: /sw.js response headers not specified
findings.fix: Serve /sw.js with page_headers("text/javascript", "no-cache") or an equivalent that includes img-src 'self'

findings.title: Lane host check must use the same EndpointPolicy as subscribe
findings.fix: Both checks call one policy object
